**Residual Value Risk Management in Automotive Leasing**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22810796`）**是一份**把**「**汽车**租赁**残值**风险」**做**成**预警**框架**的 **R** 复现**包****——**逐字自述**研究**对象**为**韩国**汽车**市场**的**成交**数据**，**并**把 **OTS（**Offer Timing Score，**Ko **2026）**与 **RDD（**Relative Downside Deviation）**结**合**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**非 **GitHub** 的**代码**托管面**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-23 Zenodo 记录接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**用**两**个**互补**指标**并**给出**可**检验**的**时**序**关系**（**先**期**权**价值**衰**减**、**后**下行**偏离）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**While RDD measures downside deviation risk, OTS complements it by capturing the urgency of risk response associated with option value erosion. The results indicate that spikes in RDD tend to occur after changes in OTS with a time lag, suggesting its usefulness as an early-warning signal.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**预警**」**这**个**词**在**实务**里**常**被**用**得**很**松**（**任何**指标**下降**都**叫**预警）**，**而**这**里**给**出**了**一**个**可**检验**的**判据**：**⭐ 「**A** 变动**后**隔**一**段**时间 **B** 才**动」**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**早期**预警**类**作业**时**，**要**给**出**领先**指标**与**滞后**指标**的**时**序**证据**（**如**互**相关**），**而**不**只**是**把**两**个**指标**画**在**一**张**图**上**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**给**出**一**个**具体**的**分布**结论**（**残值**服从 **Weibull）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**Empirical results show that used-vehicle residual values are well characterized by a Weibull distribution.**」**，**并**说明**脚本**含**「**Weibull MLE parameter estimation**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**残值**是**「**有**下**界**、**右**偏**、**随**车龄**单**调**衰**减」**的**量**，**而 **Weibull** 的**形状**与**尺度**参数**恰好**能**表达**「**什**么**时候**开**始**快**速**贬**值」**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**资产**侧**或**残值**保险**相关**作业**时**，**先**用 **`fitdistrplus`** 之类**工具**比**几**个**候选**分布**，**而**不**默**认**对数**正态**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**把**「**该**不**该**干**预」**写**成**期**权**问题****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**列**出**脚本**内容**含**「**put option pricing**」**，**并**逐字**给出**研究**目的**「**to assess proactive intervention timing**」**与**「**OTS-based retention strategies may support both residual value risk management and customer retention**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**：**⭐ 即**「**客户**提前**还**车**或**续**约」**在**租赁**公司**看**来**是**处**置**一**个**随**时**间**衰**减**的**选**择**权**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**是**「**用**金融**工程**语言**表**达**运**营**决策」**的**好**例**子**（**⭐ 与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**把**限额**指数化**单列**为**一**类**风险」**同**属**「**把**业**务**动作**翻**译**成**可**计量」**一**类）**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**的**技术**栈**、**目录**结构**与**运行**方式**都**逐字**写**明****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**列**出 **`OTS.Rproj`**、**`scripts/`（**含**数据**预**处理**、**异常**检测 **EIF／**LOF／**IQR、**Weibull **MLE、**看跌**期权**定价**与 **CCF** 稳健性**校验）**、**`data/`**、**`output/`**，**并**逐字**列**出 **16** 个 **R** 包**（**含 **`conflicted`／**`data.table`／**`dbscan`／**`dplyr`／**`fitdistrplus`／**`ggplot2`／**`isotree`／**`openxlsx`／**`patchwork`／**`zoo` 等）**与**运行**方式**（**在 **RStudio** 打开 **`OTS.Rproj`** 并**执行 **`scripts/`** 内**主**脚本**、**先**把**数据**放**入 **`data/`）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**列出**依赖**包**＋**写**明**目录**约定**＋**给**出**一**个**入口**文件」**是**让**别人**能**跑**起来**的**最低**配置**（**⭐ 而**它**没**有**给**出**运行**顺序**以外**的**环境**版本**，**故**复现**仍**可能**受 **R** 版本**影响）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元数据**与**窗口****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**发布日 **2026-09-17****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`dataset`****、**许可逐字 **`mit-license`****、**作者逐字 **`Ko, Seok Bin`****、**文件**逐字 **`Zenodo.zip`（**33,838,838 B）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**它**的**类型**被**标**为 **`dataset`**，**而**其**实际**内容**是 **R** 脚本**＋**数据**＋**输出**的**混**合**包**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**元数据**里的 **`type`** 是**作者**自**报**的**，**读**者**应**按**内容**而**不**是**按**标签**判断**能**不能**用**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-telematics]] 与 **[[zenroad-telematics]] 覆盖**车联网**数据**、**[[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 覆盖**精算**可**复现**工作**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**成**交**数据**做**残值**分布**拟合**、**并**用**期**权**定价**定**干预**时点」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **预警**要**给**出**领先**与**滞后**的**时**序**证据**；**② **分布**要**比**选**而**不**默**认**；**③ **把**运营**决策**翻**译**成**期**权**语言**；**④ **依赖**包**与**目录**约定**写**清**，**并**给**一**个**入口**文件**；**⑤ **元数据 **`type`** 是**自**报**的**，**按**内容**判断**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**其 **zip**（**33,838,838 B）**、**未**安装 **R** 环境**、**未重跑**其**任何**脚本**，**故**不**主张**其**可**复现**性**、**分布**拟合**正确性**或**结论**稳健**性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**Zenodo** 记录**接口**返回的**元数据与描述**（**描述**实测 **2,484** 字符）**，**未读**其 **R** 代码**或**数据**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **Weibull** 结论**是否**与**替代**分布**做过**正式**比较**（**描述**只**写 **`well characterized`）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **OTS** 与 **RDD** 的**定义**与**计算**细节**（**描述**只**说 **`proposed by Ko(2026)`）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**时**滞**结论**的**统计**显著**性**与**样本**规模**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**韩国**成交**数据**的**来源**与**授权**（**⭐ 描述**未**说明**数据**是否**公开**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**发布日 **2026-09-17** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-23）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-23 所见**；**⚠️ 涉及**汽车**租赁**残值**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**资产**估值**或**定价**建议**。

e.body_en:
This is an R replication package that turns residual value risk in automotive leasing into an early-warning framework, studying transaction data from one national automotive market and combining an offer timing score with relative downside deviation. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the non-GitHub code hosting surface.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-23 from the record interface**:
**First, it uses two complementary indicators and reports a checkable time ordering in which option value decay moves before measured downside deviation.** The description states that relative downside deviation measures the risk while the offer timing score captures the urgency of response associated with option value erosion, and that spikes in downside deviation tend to occur after changes in the timing score with a time lag, which suggests an early-warning signal. **Warning is a loosely used word in practice, where any indicator turning down may be called a warning, whereas here there is a checkable criterion: one quantity moves and another follows after a delay, so early-warning coursework should provide lead-lag evidence such as cross-correlation rather than two lines on one chart.**
**Second, it reports a concrete distributional finding that used-vehicle residual values are well characterised by a Weibull distribution**, with the scripts stated to include maximum likelihood estimation of the Weibull parameters. **Residual value is bounded below, right skewed, and decaying with vehicle age, so a Weibull shape and scale can express when depreciation accelerates, which argues for comparing candidate distributions rather than defaulting to a lognormal in asset-side or residual-value work.**
**Third, it frames the intervention question as an option problem.** The description lists put option pricing among the script contents and states the aim of assessing proactive intervention timing, with simulation results implying that score-based retention strategies may support both residual value risk management and customer retention. **Early return or renewal is, from the lessor point of view, the disposal of an option whose value decays with time, which makes this a good example of expressing an operational decision in financial engineering language, in the same family as the earlier note about separating cap indexation as its own risk source.**
**Fourth, its stack, directory layout, and run instructions are all stated in writing.** The description lists a project file, a scripts directory containing preprocessing, outlier detection by three methods, Weibull estimation, put option pricing, and cross-correlation robustness validation, plus data and output directories, sixteen required R packages, and the instruction to open the project file and run the main script after placing data in the data folder. **Listing dependencies, fixing a directory convention, and naming one entry file is the minimum configuration for someone else to run it, although no version pins are given so reproduction may still depend on the R version.**
**Fifth, metadata and window status.** Released on the seventeenth of September inside the window, typed as a dataset, MIT licensed, credited to one author, and shipped as one archive of about thirty-four megabytes. **Its declared type is a dataset while its actual contents are a mixed package of scripts, data, and outputs, so a reader should judge usability from contents rather than from the label, since the type field is self-reported.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover telematics data sources and reproducible actuarial work, **while this entry supplies the form of fitting a residual value distribution to transaction data and using option pricing to time an intervention. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: give lead-lag evidence for a warning; compare candidate distributions rather than defaulting; translate an operational decision into option language; state dependencies and directory conventions with a single entry file; and judge an artefact by content rather than by its declared type.**

**Residual Value Risk Management in Automotive Leasing**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22810796`）**是一份**把**「**汽車租賃殘值風險」**做成**預警框架的 R 復現包****——**逐字自述**研究對象為韓國汽車市場的成交數據**，**並把 OTS（**Offer Timing Score，**Ko 2026）與 RDD（**Relative Downside Deviation）結合**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**非 GitHub 的代碼託管面**」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-23 Zenodo 記錄介面實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 兩個互補指標＋可檢驗的時序關係**——**逐字**While RDD measures downside deviation risk, OTS complements it by capturing the urgency of risk response associated with option value erosion. The results indicate that spikes in RDD tend to occur after changes in OTS with a time lag, suggesting its usefulness as an early-warning signal.**；**⭐ 即**預警要給出領先與滯後的時序證據**（**如互相關）**，**而不是把兩個指標畫在一張圖上**。
**⭐⭐ ② 具體分布結論：殘值服從 Weibull**——**逐字**Empirical results show that used-vehicle residual values are well characterized by a Weibull distribution.** 與 **Weibull MLE parameter estimation**；**⭐ 即**有下界、**右偏、**隨車齡單調衰減的量適合 Weibull**，**不要預設對數正態**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 把該不該干預寫成期權問題**——**逐字**put option pricing** 與 **to assess proactive intervention timing**；**⭐ 即**客戶提前還車或續約是處置一個隨時間衰減的選擇權**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 技術棧、**目錄結構與**運行方式逐字寫明**——**逐字**`OTS.Rproj`、**`scripts/`（**含 EIF／**LOF／**IQR 異常檢測、**Weibull MLE、**看跌期權定價與 CCF 校驗）**、**`data/`、**`output/`**，**並列 16 個 R 包**（**含 fitdistrplus／**isotree／**dbscan／**patchwork／**zoo 等）**；**⭐ 即**列依賴 ＋ **寫目錄約定 ＋ **給入口文件是最低配置**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元數據與窗口**——**發布日 2026-09-17**、**類型 `dataset`**、**許可 `mit-license`**、**作者 `Ko, Seok Bin`**、**文件 `Zenodo.zip`（33,838,838 B）**；**⭐ 即**type 是作者自報的**，**要按內容而非標籤判斷**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurance-telematics]]、[[zenroad-telematics]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以成交數據做殘值分布擬合、**並用期權定價定干預時點**」**這一形態**。
**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **預警給時序證據**；**② **分布比選**；**③ **決策翻成期權語言**；**④ **依賴與目錄約定寫清**；**⑤ **按內容判斷類型**。
